author: marthomahew
name: remindme
short: Reminders that come back as a reply in the same channel.
description: Set reminders with /remindme, !remindme 2h note (or as a reply to a message), a bare !remindme (opens a form), or right-click a message → Apps → Remind me about this. The reminder replies to the original message in the same channel.
install_msg: Loaded? As bot owner: `[p]slash enable remindme`, `[p]slash enable reminders`, `[p]slash enable "Remind me about this" message`, then `[p]slash sync`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores reminders you set (your user ID, the channel, the message it replies to, the time and your note) until they fire. Red's data deletion removes them.
